phase: public-stress-v2; source-path implementation amendment after interrupted v1; exploratory
amendment: v1 could not load valid NETLIB MPS files via Windows Unicode absolute path. v2 uses an ASCII relative path to the identical bytes. All mathematical parameters, candidate IDs, masks, seeds and metrics unchanged. v1 partial rows and errors retained separately, never pooled with v2.
admission: All listed candidates attempted. Source optimal values checked before context generation. Unsupported parsing, download failure, mismatch or solver limit recorded, no replacement.
lossScale: max(1, mean over training of abs(known cost dot observed decision))
normalization: Divide original objective coefficients by median absolute nonzero KNOWN original costs after masking; hidden theta=absolute hidden coefficient divided by this known-only scale, feature sign assumed known. No rescaling by hidden oracle or test.
contexts: Feasible sets unchanged; known nonzero costs independently multiplied by Uniform(0.5,1.5); hidden true costs fixed. Same contexts across methods. No retries or replacement for infeasible/unbounded contexts.
noise: Optimize fixed random linear auxiliary objective under certified oracle cost + cap*max(1,abs(oracle)). It is a cost gap cap, not percent corrupted histories. Failures block dependent rows explicitly.
structure: Controlled template includes two true signed cost features and one distractor. All5 bank contains additional3. No real text comprehension or hidden constraint discovery claim.
primary: K10/noise0.1, source-equal means over3seeds, each dataset separately. Every scheduled row and failed test retained; no successful-only mean presented as full-cohort mean.
uncertainty: 5000 source-paired bootstrap resamples, seed20261022; unadjusted exploratory intervals, no confirmatory significance claims; report win/tie/loss and per-source min/median/max.
diagnostics: Primary rows: estimated-optimal-face best/worst true-cost with absolute cost slack1e-7, plus L1 distance of those witnesses from default (not maximum distance over the face). For unregularized selected3 fit: parameter min/max among normalized empirical-loss minimizers +1e-6 within box[0,10]. Box endpoint is not data identification. Record true-value containment, activation and profile width.
subgradient: 50 cyclic updates projected to box and selected3; start[1,1,0,0,0], U/sqrt(t)/max(1,norm(gradient)); choose best full-training loss at initial and every10steps, no test tuning.
center: Minimize unregularized selected3 empirical loss then L1 distance to[1,1,0] among near-minimizers within1e-6 normalized loss.
random: One deterministic Uniform(0,10) draw per hidden coefficient per source-seed, nuisance0; no history learning.
resourceAccounting: Per-row wall seconds, process CPU seconds, forward calls, solver runtime, statuses, limits; per-process peak RSS where OS available; whole-run wall and aggregate child CPU. CPU counters and peak RSS are not energy or monetary estimates.
api: No paid API needed for mathematical failure audit; authorized if later needed, log usage explicitly.
preservation: No earlier MAMO data, metrics, report or archive overwritten. Post-outcome corrections require append-only amendment with old failed evidence retained.
